items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Well, David Doss, take him, he was pretty nice.

ctx.x: You didn't know King Oliver even in Chicago?

Yeah, I said yeah, yeah. Yeah, I said. When I first hit Chicago I went right away to playin' at the place called Plantation. Right straight there. Well who were some good jazz drummers? Well, David Doss, take him, he was pretty nice.
And you mean in New Orleans? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
